descriptions.value: The crisis was triggered on October 16, 1907 by the failed attempt by New York speculators F. Augustus Heinze and Charles W. Morse to corner the stock of United Copper Company, which eroded depositor confidence and sparked runs on banks affiliated with the two speculators; the New York Clearing House (NYCH) intervened on October 20, 1907 to stabilize member banks via solvency assurances, management restructuring and liquidity support, ending initial runs on member banks.
evidence_source_contents: 1907年10月16日，纽约金融家Heinze和Morse试图垄断United Copper Company的股票，以失败告终，这次失败导致了与该计划有关的两家经纪公司的破产，并引发了与Heinze及Morse相关的银行及信托公司的挤兑
4天后，纽清所发布公开告示称，经审查，与海因策有关的银行，如美国商业国家银行（Mercantile National Bank），仍有偿付能力。这一举动大大安抚了储户情绪。同时，清算所还迫使包括海因策和莫尔斯在内的这些银行管理层离职，然后向这些银行提供贷款支持

Preceded by an economic slowdown, the panic was precipitated by the failed attempt by speculators Augustus Heinze and Charles Morse to corner the shares of the United Copper Company. This eroded depositor confidence in banks associated with the copper speculators and led to runs on these banks. An immediate response by the New York Clearinghouse (NYCH) to assist these troubled banks quickly ended the runs.

descriptions.value: Between October 21 and October 25 1907, panic spread to non-NYCH member trust companies: Knickerbocker Trust faced intensifying runs after its emergency aid requests to NYCH and J.P. Morgan were rejected, suspended operations on October 22 1907 following $8 million in depositor withdrawals, triggering widespread financial contagion across other New York trust companies; the New York Stock Exchange call loan market seized up, with annualized call loan rates spiking to 100% amid extreme liquidity shortages, risking a total exchange shutdown.
evidence_source_contents: 10月21号，国家商业银行代表尼克博克向纽清所申请了紧急贷款的请求。然而，该项请求却被纽清所以“不为成员银行外金融机构提供服务”的理由断然拒绝...摩根也因此拒绝了对尼克博克的援助...第二天，在储户提取了近800万美元后，该公司暂停了运营。尼克博克信托的停业引发了纽约市的全面金融危机。挤兑在各信托公司之间蔓延
trust companies and national banks were notable creditors to the New York Stock Exchange; when trusts were suffering runs, the call loan market on the stock exchange seized
在10月22日尼克博克停业当天，年化利率从9.5%跃升至70%，两天后又升至100%。即使在如此之高的利率下，也一贷难求。纽约证交所之所以能继续营业，很大程度上要归功于摩根传奇的救市行动

descriptions.value: Formal containment measures were implemented on October 26 1907, when NYCH established a special loan issuance team to provide emergency liquidity to member banks via clearing house loan certificates (precursor to the Federal Reserve discount window) and coordinated member banks to suspend deposit convertibility to mitigate run pressure; J.P. Morgan led private sector bailout efforts, pooling personal and peer capital to inject liquidity into distressed trust companies and NYSE brokers to prevent market collapse; gold imports from Europe attracted by the resulting currency premium restored systemic liquidity by January 1908, ending the acute phase of the crisis.
evidence_source_contents: 10月26日，经过不同寻常的5日延误，纽清所委员会召开会议，并成立了贷款投放特别小组。这些贷款是美联储贴现窗口的前身，为金融系统提供了暂时的流动性支撑。同日，纽清所成员银行一致暂停了存款的兑现业务
如果不是金融家J.P.摩根的干预，这场危机可能会更加严重。摩根用自己的大量资金，并说服其他纽约银行家也这样做，来支撑银行系统...他动用私人关系，直接从大型金融和工业机构中募集了大量资金，并把资金送达纽约证交所，支持仍在交易并需要信贷的经纪商
The suspension of convertibility produced a currency premium, which in turn attracted gold imports from Europe. The gold imports ultimately restored liquidity to financial markets.

descriptions.value: The severity of the Panic of 1907 exposed critical gaps in the US banking system's liquidity response and regulatory framework, catalyzing post-crisis reform: Congress established the National Monetary Commission to evaluate banking system reforms, whose recommendations led to the passage of the Federal Reserve Act on December 23 1913, establishing the Federal Reserve System as the US central bank to act as a lender of last resort and mitigate systemic financial risk.
evidence_source_contents: The Bank Panic of 1907 was so serious that it became a catalyst for the creation of Americas central bank

As a result of the 1907 crisis, the Congress set up the National Monetary Commission to consider whether the federal government should more actively manage the nation's money supply. The committee's recommendations led to the creation of the Federal Reserve.
1907年银行恐慌危机暴露出美国银行业监管不足的问题，特别是在流动性方面。这导致了政府对银行业进行改革，增加了对银行的监管和控制。最终，这种改革催生了1913年通过的《联邦储备法》，建立了美国的中央银行，即美联储。
